question: Teena, Beena, Meera, Leena, Meenu and Reena are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. Reena sits second to the left of Teena. Meenu sits third to the left of Reena. Leena sits second to the left of Meera. Who sits second to the left of Beena?
solution:
Given: Teena, Beena, Meera, Leena, Meenu and Reena are sitting around a circle, facing the centre.

1) Reena sits second to the left of Teena.

2) Meenu sits third to the left of Reena.

3) Leena sits second to the left of Meera.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9394f5e852f6694b267b85b7ac0a908c89bf05fd230ed3885ed5004f72ec581e.png] 

Here, **Teena** sits second to the left of Beena.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
